name: erp_sales_order_update_status
description: Transition a sales order along its lifecycle: pendingApproval -> pendingFulfillment -> billed (cancel allowed before billing); invalid jumps are rejected (PATCH /services/rest/record/v1/salesOrder/{id})

id.description: Sales order document number (tranId), e.g. SO-2026-0103.

status.description: Target status: pendingFulfillment, billed or cancelled. Must be a valid next step from the order's current status.
